text: Create work that people return to years later.
Just beyond the surface flow the waves of life. Behind the scenes beats a human heart with a hundred stories.
How language limits me when senses would explicitly expose my inner vision. Fathomless fantasies and emergent epiphanies for those who still read between the lines.
There are singers, and then there are ENTERTAINERS… You need a showman that will bring the heat and get the crowd moving. Guaranteed.
Charismatic, quick-witted, sultry, and soulful. Your attendees don't want a talking mannequin. You need a host that does the most!
No patience for managed, softened feedback. Wants it straight, the same way he wants the work itself.
The pause before a verse does as much work as the verse itself.
Singer, songwriter, poet, live looper, MC/host, voice actor, treated as one continuous instrument rather than separate careers.
